subject: RiverMark onboarding: compliance handoff, IR timelines & evidence
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Chen <alice.chen@rivermark.com>, Marcus Lee <marcus.lee@rivermark.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: RiverMark onboarding: compliance handoff, IR timelines & evidence

Hi Alice / Marcus —

Great to chat earlier. Quick recap from today's discovery so we have a shared set of next steps on the security/compliance items that RiverMark flagged: 

- SOC 2: RiverMark asked about our SOC 2 status and any recent bridge letters or gap remediation.
- GDPR/HIPAA: confirmation on data residency options and pseudonymization for PII/HIPAA flows.
- Incident response & breach notification: request for documented timelines, escalation points, and sample evidence (playbook snippets, notification templates).
- BCP/DR: high-level diagram and RTO/RPO commitments for dedicated deployments; sample runbook or tabletop notes.

Next steps I propose:
1) Monica (copied) to share SOC 2 status, a one-page summary, and playbook excerpt by EOD Monday.
2) Internal security Q: Marcus, if you can send over your vendor security questionnaire (VSA) we will start populating the attachments column — preferred format: XLSX.
3) Schedule a short follow-up (30 min) next week to review evidence and any redlines.

Ben
Ben Carter | Enterprise Sales 
Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0172

---
Attachments: redwood-soc2-status-summary.pdf (PDF, 220KB)
From: Alice Chen <alice.chen@rivermark.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@rivermark.com
Date: Fri, 26 Jun 2026 09:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: RiverMark onboarding: compliance handoff, IR timelines & evidence

Thanks Ben — appreciated. A couple of clarifying items from our security team: 

1) SOC 2: We need to know whether Redwood has a current Type II report (last 12 months) or an attestation that covers the hosted API. If you only have control mappings or a Type I, please flag gaps.
2) IR timelines: for breach notification we have a policy requiring initial acknowledgement to stakeholders within 24 hours and a substantive update within 72 hours. We need to confirm Redwood can meet those timelines and provide an example IR timeline with sample notification text.
3) BCP/DR: we need RTO/RPO numbers for dedicated pools and, critically, any cross-region failover playbooks — do you conduct automated failover between regions?

I'll attach our vendor security questionnaire (VSA) in XLSX and a quick list of priority questions to speed the review. 

Can Monica and your security lead respond to items 1–3? Also propose a 30-min call Tuesday 6/30 10am PT.

Cheers,
Alice
Alice Chen | Head of Trust & Security, RiverMark Financial
alice.chen@rivermark.com | +1 212-555-0134

Alice —

Thanks for the detail and for sending the VSA. Looping in Monica (Security Ops lead) and Lauren (engagement lead) to take point on written artifacts. 

Monica — can you confirm the current SOC 2 posture and attach the one-page summary and the IR playbook excerpt you referenced? If we have a bridge letter or any compensating controls that are specific to hosted API vs Dedicated, please call those out. Also please include RTO/RPO for Dedicated and notes on cross-region failover behavior.

We can do 6/30 10am PT — I'll send a calendar invite pending your confirmation.

Ben

Subject: Re: RiverMark onboarding: compliance handoff, IR timelines & evidence

Hi Alice —

Thanks for the VSA and the clear ask. Attaching a short packet (SOC 2 status page + IR playbook excerpt + BCP diagram) that should cover your immediate review. High-level answers below: 

SOC 2
- Status: We maintain a SOC 2 Type II attestation covering hosted API and core infra, report period ended 2026-03-31. Full report is available under NDA; summary attached (redwood-soc2-status-summary.pdf).
- Coverage notes: Dedicated deployments have identical control mappings; where customers have stricter isolation needs we offer Private deployment with customer-controlled network/KMS.

Incident response & breach notification
- Acknowledgement: We commit to an initial acknowledgement within 24 hours of confirmed incident detection.
- Substantive update: We aim for a substantive update within 72 hours; frequency thereafter depends on impact.
- Sample timeline: detection (T+0), initial notification (T+<=24h), preliminary impact assessment (T+24-48h), substantive update (T+72h). Excerpt attached (ir-playbook-excerpt.pdf) with sample stakeholder notification text and primary escalation contacts.

BCP / DR
- Dedicated RTO/RPO: Typical RTO 4 hours, RPO 1 hour for our reserved GPU pool configurations. These are configurable per contract and differ for Private deployments.
- Cross-region failover: We support automated routing failover at the load-balancer layer for hosted service and customer-configurable replication for Dedicated; cross-region KV-cache warmup is manual in most configs — we include playbook steps in the BCP diagram (bcp-diagram.png).

Attachments: redwood-soc2-status-summary.pdf, ir-playbook-excerpt.pdf, bcp-diagram.png

If you'd like the full SOC 2 Type II under NDA we can initiate an NDA and share the report. Also happy to run through the VSA — Marcus, can you confirm any priority sections so we can triage?

Regards,
Monica Patel
Security Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai | +1 650-555-0199
From: Alice Chen <alice.chen@rivermark.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>

Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 09:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: RiverMark onboarding: compliance handoff, IR timelines & evidence

Monica / Ben —

Received, thanks. The SOC 2 summary and IR excerpt look good at a high level. Two quick follow-ups before the call: 

- NDA: we'll send a standard mutual NDA by EOD so we can receive the full Type II report.
- VSA priorities: Marcus will flag sections on encryption key management, third-party subprocessor lists, and data retention limits — those will be top of our list.

We'll be on the 10am PT call; sharing a calendar accept now. If anything else comes up beforehand I'll flag it in the VSA.

Best,
Alice
